svg.text: Each arrow points from a unit to a unit it uses (its uses clause). Units higher up depend on units lower down; nothing points upwards, so there are no cycles.

Generated from the source on 2026-09-28 (38 units, 107 uses). Light arrows go to the shared basics (uTypes, uCommands, uStopwatch, uIOGate, uMemoryGuard); dashed = used in the implementation section only.
fast TIFF: raw rows, own LZW
L0 … L6: dependency depth (L0 uses no other MView unit). Dashed box: retired unit, still compiled.
